criteria.text: Sony startup is nonblocking and shutdown stops the injected manager for SIGINT and SIGTERM.
Status routes delegate lifecycle and upstream operations to the injected SonyManager with curated retry and error responses.
Unknown discovery never auto-connects; successful explicit connect persists approval, restart reconnects approved cameras, and Forget prevents reconnect.
The dashboard renders connected cameras only and Device Config renders named Sony sidecar and camera control states without polling discovery every five seconds.
Sony properties, live-view frames, touch, the six-property allowlist, safe alphanumeric/colon IDs, and redacted upstream errors remain supported.

Connected cameras render a noninteractive Connected status; only disconnected, needs_pairing, and error render Retry Connect, discovered_unapproved renders Connect, connecting is disabled, and approved cameras retain Forget.
